tspan.tspan: Throughput vs concurrency, and the backend ratio at matched precision — Llama-3.1-8B
Top: total tokens/s (steady window; error bars ±1 SD over 3 repetitions in one server instance). Bottom: vLLM ÷ llama.cpp at equal C, BF16 pair solid, INT8 pair dashed
